title: Show HN: Flipflop, Iroh-powered persistent tunnels for filesharing
summary: Flipflop is a file sharing application built with Iroh and Slint framework that creates persistent tunnels for fast, always-on file transfers between devices and trusted external contacts. It addresses limitations of existing tools like LocalSend by enabling reliable external device communication.
problem_solved: Enables persistent, fast file sharing with trusted external parties beyond local network boundaries without relying on cloud services.
why_valuable: Provides a self-hosted alternative for cross-device and cross-network file sharing with end-to-end encryption through Iroh's hole-punching capabilities.
